description.zh: 异环游戏常见技术问题、账户问题和游戏Bug的完整排查指南，包含详细解决方案。
description.en: Complete troubleshooting guide for Neverness to Everness common technical issues, account problems, and game bugs with detailed solutions.

description.zh: 下载启动器后游戏内容无法下载或停止工作
description.en: After downloading the launcher, game content won't download or stops working

steps.zh:
1) 以管理员身份运行启动器
2) 检查杀毒软件是否拦截，添加白名单
3) 确保安装盘有50GB以上空间
4) 检查网络连接和代理设置
steps.en:
1) Run the launcher as administrator
2) Check if antivirus is blocking it, add an exception
3) Ensure at least 50GB free space on the install drive
4) Check network connection and proxy settings

description.zh: 打开游戏后立即崩溃，无法进入主界面
description.en: Game crashes immediately after opening, can't reach the main menu

steps.zh:
1) 完全重启设备（不是休眠）
2) 检查游戏是否有待更新
3) PC：通过启动器验证游戏文件
4) 手机：清除应用缓存
5) PS5：删除重装（存档数据在服务器安全）
steps.en:
1) Fully restart your device (not just sleep mode)
2) Check for pending game updates
3) PC: Verify game files through the launcher
4) Mobile: Clear the app cache
5) PS5: Delete and reinstall (save data is safe on the server)

description.zh: PS5/PC/手机账号进度不同步，如何绑定
description.en: PS5/PC/Mobile account progress not syncing, how to link

steps.zh:
1) 在已有进度的设备上进入 设置 > 账号中心 > 绑定账号
2) 绑定所有登录方式（Google、邮箱、PSN）
3) 在新设备上使用已绑定的登录方式登录
4) 注意：Google登录和邮箱登录是两种不同的登录方式，需都绑定
5) 如已创建独立账号，联系 nte.contactus@perfectworld.com 提供两个UID
steps.en:
1) On the device with progress, go to Settings > Account Center > Link Account
2) Link all login methods (Google, email, PSN)
3) On the new device, log in with any linked method
4) Note: Google login and email login are separate — link both
5) If you already created separate accounts, email nte.contactus@perfectworld.com with both UIDs

description.zh: 预注册了但游戏内没收到奖励
description.en: Pre-registered but didn't receive rewards in-game

steps.zh:
1) 检查游戏内邮箱，奖励通过邮件发放
2) 确认当前登录的账号与预注册邮箱一致
3) 重启游戏等待同步
4) 如仍无奖励，联系 nte.contactus@perfectworld.com 提供UID和预注册邮箱
steps.en:
1) Check your in-game mail — rewards are delivered there
2) Verify you're logged in with the same email used for pre-registration
3) Restart the game to trigger sync
4) If still missing, email nte.contactus@perfectworld.com with your UID and pre-registration email

description.zh: 登出后无法重新登录，系统提示账号不存在
description.en: Can't log back in after logging out, system says account doesn't exist

steps.zh:
1) 尝试其他登录方式（Facebook、Google、邮箱等）
2) 不要创建新账号
3) 检查是否选对了服务器
4) 联系 nte.contactus@perfectworld.com 提供角色名、UID、绑定邮箱等信息
steps.en:
1) Try other login methods (Facebook, Google, email, etc.)
2) Do NOT create a new account
3) Check if you're on the correct server
4) Email nte.contactus@perfectworld.com with your character name, UID, and linked email

description.zh: 游戏画面卡顿，尤其是开车和战斗时
description.en: Game stutters, especially during driving and combat

steps.zh:
1) 在设置 > 画面中切换渲染器（DX11/DX12/Vulkan），选择最流畅的一个
2) 降低阴影和抗锯齿设置
3) 更新GPU驱动到最新版本
4) 如果游戏装在D盘，尝试移到C盘（多名玩家确认有效）
5) 关闭后台占用大的应用
steps.en:
1) Switch renderer between DX11/DX12/Vulkan in Settings > Graphics
2) Lower shadows and anti-aliasing
3) Update GPU drivers to the latest version
4) If installed on a secondary drive, move to the OS drive (C:) — confirmed fix by multiple players
5) Close heavy background apps

title.zh: 安装在D盘导致严重卡顿
title.en: Severe stuttering when installed on secondary drive

description.zh: 游戏安装在非系统盘时出现严重卡顿，移到C盘后恢复正常
description.en: Game stutters severely on non-OS drive, fixed by moving to C: drive

steps.zh:
这是一个已知问题：将游戏移到系统盘（C盘）即可解决。1) 卸载当前安装
2) 在C盘重新安装
3) 存档数据在服务器端，无需担心丢失进度
steps.en: This is a known issue. Move the game to your OS drive (C:) to fix it. 1) Uninstall current installation 2) Reinstall on C: drive 3) Save data is server-side, no progress loss

title.zh: 画面模糊/角色变黑紫色

description.zh: 游戏画面模糊、延迟，角色模型变成黑色或紫色
description.en: Blurry image, delayed rendering, character models turn black or purple

steps.zh:
1) 更新GPU驱动（NVIDIA/AMD/Intel）
2) 切换渲染器（DX11/DX12/Vulkan）
3) 清理着色器缓存
4) 降低贴图质量，关闭体积光效果
5) 手机用户确保设备至少有6GB内存
steps.en:
1) Update GPU drivers (NVIDIA/AMD/Intel)
2) Switch renderer between DX11/DX12/Vulkan
3) Clear shader cache
4) Lower texture quality and disable volumetric effects
5) On mobile, ensure your device has at least 6GB RAM

title.en: Hunter level stuck and won't increase

description.zh: 经验值超过上限但等级不提升
description.en: EXP exceeds cap but level won't increase

steps.zh: 猎人等级在特定阈值（如20级、30级）有软上限。检查任务列表中是否有「猎人晋升」相关的主线任务，完成该任务即可解锁下一等级段。经验会保留，解锁后自动提升。
steps.en: Hunter level has soft caps at certain thresholds (e.g., Lv20, Lv30). Check your quest log for a main story quest or "Hunter Promotion" quest. Complete it to unlock the next level tier. Accumulated EXP will apply automatically.

description.zh: 角色卡在墙壁、地板或建筑内无法移动
description.en: Character stuck inside walls, floors, or buildings

steps.zh:
1) 传送到其他地图点位
2) 进入建筑/室内触发加载
3) 重启游戏
4) 使用游戏内的「脱离卡死」功能
5) 联系 nte.contactus@perfectworld.com 提供UID和位置信息
steps.en:
1) Teleport to another map location
2) Enter a building/interior to trigger a loading screen
3) Restart the game
4) Use the in-game "Unstuck" feature
5) Email nte.contactus@perfectworld.com with your UID and location

title.zh: 任务无法推进/触发器失效
title.en: Quest not progressing / trigger not working

description.zh: 到达任务地点但NPC不出现，交互点无反应
description.en: Arrived at quest location but NPC doesn't appear, interaction point not working

steps.zh:
1) 传送离开当前区域后返回
2) 重启游戏
3) 检查是否在正确的异常区域阶段
4) 如仍无法解决，联系 nte.contactus@perfectworld.com 提供UID、任务名称和问题描述
steps.en:
1) Teleport away and come back
2) Restart the game
3) Check if you're on the correct anomaly zone stage
4) If still stuck, email nte.contactus@perfectworld.com with UID, quest name, and description

description.en: Pressing L1+R1 doesn't open vehicle wheel

steps.zh:
1) 检查设置 > 控制中载具快捷键是否正确绑定，近期更新可能重置了键位
2) 重启游戏
3) PC端尝试键盘载具快捷键
4) 如仍无效，联系 nte.contactus@perfectworld.com
steps.en:
1) Check Settings > Controls — recent patches may have reset bindings
2) Restart the game
3) On PC, try the keyboard vehicle shortcut
4) If still broken, email nte.contactus@perfectworld.com

description.zh: 月卡、通行证、充值等购买后游戏内没有收到
description.en: Monthly pass, premium pass, or crystals not delivered after purchase

steps.zh:
1) 重启游戏，购买有时需要重启才同步
2) 检查游戏内邮箱
3) 确认付款确实扣款成功
4) 联系 nte.contactus@perfectworld.com 提供UID、平台和购买凭证截图
steps.en:
1) Restart the game — purchases sometimes need a restart to sync
2) Check your in-game mail
3) Verify the payment actually went through
4) Email nte.contactus@perfectworld.com with UID, platform, and purchase receipt screenshot

description.zh: 一笔订单被扣了两次费用

steps.zh:
1) 准备两笔交易的截图和交易ID
2) 联系 nte.contactus@perfectworld.com 申请退款
3) 同时通过购买平台申请退款（Epic/Google Play/App Store/PlayStation）
4) 保留所有收据作为凭证
steps.en:
1) Prepare screenshots and transaction IDs for both charges
2) Email nte.contactus@perfectworld.com to request a refund
3) Also request refund through your purchase platform (Epic/Google Play/App Store/PlayStation)
4) Keep all receipts as proof

channels.zh: 游戏内：设置 > 客服/反馈 | 邮箱：nte.contactus@perfectworld.com | PlayStation：通过PSN Support反馈
channels.en: In-game: Settings > Customer Service / Feedback | Email: nte.contactus@perfectworld.com | PlayStation: Report via PSN Support

tip.zh: 联系官方客服时请准备好：UID、服务器、问题描述和截图，可以加快处理速度。
tip.en: When contacting official support, include your UID, server, issue description, and screenshots for faster resolution.
